name: Leaders-in-Training (LIT) at Park'n It Day Camp
city: Alameda and Contra Costa Counties, CA (regional parks)
what_you_do: For one week you work with other teens to help lead a day camp for kids in a regional park. You learn real job skills.
who_can_apply: Teens ages 13 to 17. The program page does not list a grade or home city rule.
pay_detail: $50 for the one week. A limited number of $30 scholarships are available. The page lists 35 community service hours and does not mention pay.
deadline_text: The program page says applications open in 2027 and gives no date. Interviews are in late April. Accepted teens hear back by mid-May.
how_to_apply: Apply when applications open in 2027. If you are picked after the interview, you then register for the week. Ask about the $30 scholarship through the park district financial aid line.
notes: The program page says teens earn 35 community service hours, build job skills and may get a future camp job. It does not name the parks. Contact: Stewart Reid, Recreation Coordinator, 510-544-2558. Financial aid: 1-888-327-2757, option 2.
